prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1326; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just be called the claimant on this, if that's alright. I'm the one who was driving the car.
Q: That works. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in League City, Texas. I was making a left turn across the road to get into a shopping center parking lot.
Q: What were the traffic conditions when you started your turn?
A: It was fairly light. The light had just turned yellow, I think, when I started through. I was going slow, maybe ten miles an hour, because I was waiting for a gap.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you turned?
A: I saw headlights coming, but they seemed far enough away. I thought I had time. Looking back, I probably misjudged the distance.
Q: Where did the impact occur on your vehicle?
A: On the front driver's side, near the door. The other car hit the side of mine as I was almost across.
Q: Did you feel any pain at the scene?
A: Not right away. I was shaken up, but I thought I was fine. By the next morning my lower back was really stiff and sore, and it has been hurting when I sit or lift anything.
Q: Have you seen a doctor for it?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care two days later. They diagnosed a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and do some stretches.
Q: Are you still having symptoms now?
A: Yes, less than before, but I still get aching when I've been driving for a while.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you want to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm sorry the accident happened, and I'm willing to cooperate with whatever you need.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
